name: Velocidex/velociraptor
description: Velociraptor is an endpoint visibility and collection tool that uses the Velociraptor Query Language (VQL) to gather host-based state information for incident response and digital forensics. It supports enterprise-wide threat hunting and forensic investigation across Windows, Linux, and macOS.
score_rationale: Leading open-source DFIR and endpoint visibility platform with 3.8k stars, widely used by incident responders and threat hunters.
summary: Velociraptor is an endpoint visibility and collection tool that uses the Velociraptor Query Language
